name: Aurora Nexus Cloud Failsafe Robot Operation
objective: Keep Aurora Nexus online through cloud-first operation with controlled failover to the physical server and client-safe degraded modes.

failoverOrder.useWhen: cloud health checks, authenticated smoke and security gates pass
cloud workload is degraded or heavy processing is required and server is online
cloud and physical server are both unavailable or unsafe for writes
allowedWorkloads: read-only access where cached and authorized

routingRules.writeOperations: require healthy authenticated backend and rollback path
routingRules.readOperations: prefer cloud, then server cache, then client read-only cache when authorized
routingRules.heavyOperations: prefer Windows Xeon when online; otherwise queue or run in cloud only if health and cost gates allow
routingRules.bugfixOperations: cloud may prepare and validate; promotion requires gates and rollback
routingRules.clinicalSensitiveOperations: blocked until clinical-sensitive gate, backup/restore proof and formal approval pass

limits: Failsafe means autonomous prevention, failover, queueing, rollback and degraded mode; it does not guarantee impossible zero downtime under every external outage.
No credential exposure, destructive real-data action, clinical-sensitive migration or certification claim is permitted without the specific gate required by policy.
